recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If future review questions the individual reason codes, handle that as terminology/THO validation rather than as a missing core Communication binding; the core source binding requested by FHIR-12766 is present.
issue_request: FHIR-12766 was a Published/Persuasive PC change request raised against DSTU2 because Communication.notDoneReason, a CodeableConcept/Coding element, lacked a binding. The accepted resolution was to bind it to an example FHIR value set including unknown, system-error, invalid-phone-number, recipient-unavailable, family-objection, and patient-objection reasons.
initial_application: The change was explicitly applied in commit c78aa69f5a1aca8d907fedf1cdf5ce9dc5bbabb7, whose message names #12766 and whose Communication spreadsheet diff added the CommunicationNotDoneReason example binding, the communication-not-done-reason code list, and the binding on Communication.notDoneReason. Later source refactors preserved this as source/communication/structuredefinition-Communication.xml and source/communication/valueset-communication-not-done-reason.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-14063 later synchronized Communication with the workflow event pattern and renamed Communication.notDoneReason to Communication.statusReason while retaining the CommunicationNotDoneReason binding. Communication is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source binds Communication.statusReason to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/communication-not-done-reason with example strength. The current ValueSet composes the terminology.hl7.org communication-not-done-reason CodeSystem; historical release3 generated content shows the originally requested codes.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already carries the requested example binding on the current successor element, so changing source would not fix a current specification defect.
